messages.author: 8dbb28b015bb7762
messages.subject: remote + SPDE
parts:
Dear all

for quite some time I haven't been able to use the remote server option
in combination with SPDE models.

Here is a reproducible example:

inla(y ~ x,
data = transform(data.frame(x = 1:10),
y = 1 + 2*x + rnorm(10)))

example(inla.spde2.matern)

The first one runs ok, while the second one runs fine locally, but fails
when run remotely with the following outcome:

hgid: 4363963ac55d date: Mon Sep 23 15:20:17 2013 +0200
Run
/home/fmunoz/R/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-library/3.0/INLA/bin/linux/inla64 at
host 147.99.222.196



Unused entry [field|si]=[0]


inla_build: [Model.ini] contain[1] unused entries. PLEASE CHECK

*** Computations finished at Mon Mar 10 11:03:23 CET 2014
*** Transfer the results...

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it
yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
If this does help; please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

It happens to me with all models including some spde term.
I have tried this in two different servers.

My local laptop is 32 bit while the servers have been 64 bit.
I haven't been able to check otherwise, so I don't know if this can be
relevant.

I really miss being able to use this feature!!

Best regards
ƒacu.-
